cohort: Pregnant women in the Korean National Health Insurance database between 2004 and 2015, including those with diagnosed myomas (n=38,402), history of myomectomy (n=9,890), and without myoma diagnosis (n=740,675)
finding: Women with a history of myomectomy had significantly higher risks of cesarean section, placenta previa, and uterine rupture, particularly nulliparous women and those with recent myomectomy.
mod_finding: Women with a history of myomectomy had significantly higher risks of cesarean section compared to women without a diagnosed myoma.
